title: Importing soundness and completeness in modal logics
summary: We develop general strategies for transferring soundness and completeness from more expressive modal languages to less expressive ones, unifying several existing notions of operator definability along the way. For soundness, we exploit semantic insensitivity: if a less expressive language is insensitive to a frame operation, soundness extends to the operation's closure of the original frame class.
